results.raw: False. Andorra’s official gazette is the Butlletí Oficial del Principat d’Andorra (BOPA); the Portal Jurídic merely consolidates texts, so the decree cannot be “published via” the Portal.
False. The decree date (11-2-2026) precedes its claimed BOPA publication (17-2-2026), which is chronologically impossible.
False. The identifier '2024-47-RE' cannot correspond to a decision dated 2026-03-13, as that date lies in the future.
False. Andorra’s official consolidated laws are published in the Butlletí Oficial del Principat d’Andorra (BOPA), not the Andorra Portal Juridic.
False. The date 11-2-2026 is in the future, so the order cannot have been published in 2026-02-17 BOPA.
False. The identifier '2025-101-RE' cannot correspond to a decision dated 2026-03-13, as the year in the identifier precedes the decision date.
False. Fedlex publishes Swiss federal law; Andorran decrees like Decret 475/2024 are issued by Andorra’s government, not Switzerland.
False. Andorran decrees are not published on the Dutch wetten.overheid.nl portal.
False. The claim is implausible: a 2024 identifier cannot reference a 2026 date, and distinct case numbers denote separate decisions.
False. Andorra’s official gazette is the Butlletí Oficial del Principat d’Andorra, not Laws of Gibraltar.
False. Andorran ministerial orders are not published on Ireland’s Statute Database; the cited source and date are implausible.
False. The identifier '2025-102-RE' cannot correspond to '2025-101-RE' as they are distinct case numbers.
